Manim Quickstart¶

Manim is an engine for precise programmatic animations.

Introduction

This guide creates and renders a first scene.

Creating a Scene

Create a Python class derived from Scene.

from manim import *

class CreateCircle(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.play(Create(Circle()))
  • Save the file.
  • Run Manim.

Rendering

Run the command from a terminal.

manim -pql scene.py CreateCircle
